newsitem.title: UK: Sentiment carries UK grain futures higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Sentiment carries UK grain futures higher at close.

text.p: UK grains futures continued to move ahead on Monday mainly on carry-over sentiment from Friday's rally on the back of higher French markets.
Wheat futures closed 0.15 to 0.45 stg up after trading 409 lots.
Nearby September, which expired at the end of the morning session, finished 1.50 stg up with a last trade of 107.25 stg.
Barley closed 0.25 stg higher on turnover of 78 lots with September 1996 expiring at 1130 GMT unchanged on the day.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
High futures prices kept most players on the sidelines of the UK cash markets.
FOB prices were around 0.50 stg up with no business reported while delivered traders reported no business of any significance.
